scripts.prep:html: mkdir -p dist && ln -sfn ../img dist/img && ln -sfn ../resources dist/resources && ln -sfn ../../docs/plan.html dist/plan.html && ln -sfn ../../docs/plan.json dist/plan.json
scripts.prep:serve: mkdir -p .serve && ln -sfn ../presentation.md .serve/index.md && ln -sfn ../img .serve/img && ln -sfn ../resources .serve/resources && ln -sfn ../../docs/plan.html .serve/plan.html && ln -sfn ../../docs/plan.json .serve/plan.json
scripts.build: npm run prep:html && marp presentation.md --html --allow-local-files --theme-set theme --output dist/index.html
